crew.overview: A darkness swirls at the center of a world-renowned dance company, one that will engulf the artistic director, an ambitious young dancer, and a grieving psychotherapist. Some will succumb to the nightmare. Others will finally wake up.
crew.title: Suspiria

crew.overview: In the summer of 1983, a 17-year-old Elio spends his days in his family's villa in Italy. One day Oliver, a graduate student, arrives to assist Elio's father, a professor of Greco-Roman culture. Soon, Elio and Oliver discover a summer that will alter their lives forever.
crew.title: Call Me by Your Name

details.biography: Ferdinando Cito Filomarino is an Italian film director and screenwriter. In 2015, he made his feature film directorial debut Antonia., about poet Antonia Pozzi. He also directed two short films starring Małgosia Bela, Await and Closing In. In 2021 he directed the dramatic thriller Beckett, his first English-language film (for which he wrote the subject).
details.name: Ferdinando Cito Filomarino
